name: cubex
description: Work in your Cubex spreadsheets from your agent: connect and look around, clean and dedupe lists, find and fix failed rows, enrich with cost control, trace where a value came from, and check limits.

interface.longDescription: Skills for Cubex, the self-hosted spreadsheet where columns fill themselves. Add the Cubex MCP server with codex mcp add (see the setup page), then ask for a cleanup, a fix or an enrichment.
defaultPrompt: Show me my Cubex tables and what fills each column of the Leads sheet
